fixed_batch: risk: ignores candidate/channel reality; safe only when cap is lower than all gates, inefficient at scale
ladder: safe governance progression; needs manual/policy certification per step
percentage: scales with pool but unsafe alone because candidate quality/channel health can collapse
dynamic_pool_aware: best long-term, but must remain capped by certified authority and restore barrier
hybrid: recommended: dynamic desired size inside certified ladder/authority/policy/rollback/snapshot gates
